oracle.role: Numeric oracle for TTBR and PTE encode, decode, and address split. translate is not ported.

block_translation.reason: A block records raw_output, span, and the virtual offset inside that span. The physical-address output is not written. m1n1 PTE.offset returns the descriptor field, and the pinned walker does not add the low virtual bits to a block output.

checked_widths.root_input_source: m1n1 L0_OFF 39 when G >= G15 is false, matching Linux uat_ias 39
checked_widths.virtual_field_meaning: Two 39-bit roots. Bit 39 selects the root. Sign extension of that 40-bit field is accepted.
checked_widths.descriptor_field_meaning: TTBR BADDR is 47:1 and PTE OFFSET is 47:14. This width is not the output limit.

uat_t8103.h.role: Public scalar API with C++ linkage guards and has_pa field presence semantics, not completed translation. Existing limits and record layout unchanged.

uat_t8103.c.role: Encode, decode, fold, index and block refusal; identical to frozen C001 except six translated-to-has_pa identifier substitutions.

test_uat_t8103.c.role: Host assertions, including unchanged outputs and the 4096 flag combinations. NDEBUG is a compile error.

test_uat_oracle.py.role: Seeded ctypes oracle comparison, explicit expected statuses, field-presence checks, C001 archive/numeric-source fidelity, two numeric mutants and mixed C/C++ linkage with old-header negative control.

README.md.role: Revision scope, preserved C001 archive, field-presence and refusal contracts, C/C++ integration and host-only validation command.

test_uat_link.cpp.role: Same direct-header C++ caller for positive current-header linkage and negative archived-header linkage. Checks real scalar encode/decode, nonzero offset and refusal; no external extern-C wrapper.

licensing: License selection for original code remains pending under AGENTS.md. Upstream files keep their own licenses. No upstream function was copied.

references.use: Numeric facts only: TTBR ASID 63:48, BADDR 47:1, VALID 0; PTE OS 55, UXN 54, PXN 53, OFFSET 47:14, nG 11, AF 10, SH 9:8, AP 7:6, AttrIndex 4:2, TYPE 1, VALID 0; PAGE_BITS 14; L0_SIZE 2; L0_OFF 39 unless G >= G15 then 42; L1_OFF 36; L2_OFF 25; L3_OFF 14; IDX_BITS 11; Lx_SIZE 2048; NUM_CONTEXTS 64; set_l0 stride ctx * 16.
Register64 packs an inclusive msb,lsb field into a little-endian 64-bit word. The codec reimplements that packing; it does not import this module.
Version matrix G13, G14, G14X, G15, G15X. G >= G15 is the only level-0 width change, and that geometry is not accepted.
Upstream license for the reference files. It is not applied to the original codec.

references.use: T8103 chip 0x8103, GpuGen G13, uat_ias 39, uat_oas 40.

references.use: The T8122 probe comment names a 42-bit DMA mask. That number is not the g15 descriptor limit and is not a level-0 shift.

changes_from_c001: Public function declarations now have __cplusplus-guarded C linkage.
The one-byte decoded.translated field is renamed has_pa at the same offset 46 and remains PA-base presence only; struct size stays 48 bytes.
uat_t8103.c is otherwise byte-identical: exactly six identifier substitutions, no numeric behavior change.
UAT_ERR_* output preservation is distinguished from valid UAT_REFUSED facts publication; PA/facts storage must be disjoint.
A separately C-compiled object links and executes with the direct C++ header caller; the same C++ caller must compile but fail linkage with archived C001.
The named expected decode statuses are now asserted against actual C results; zero-base PA presence and nonzero VA offset semantics are tested.

decoded_pa_contract.has_pa_one: TABLE next-table base or PAGE output-page base, including zero; no VA offset added and no walk performed
decoded_pa_contract.block_refusal: UAT_REFUSED writes valid facts only; separate disjoint pa output remains unchanged. UAT_ERR_* leaves both outputs unchanged.
